mathematical_definition: MUs = sum_beams(MU_beam)
physical_meaning: Total monitor units delivered by the plan.
inputs_required: Plan MU, prescription, fraction count, beam list

mathematical_definition: PMU = MUs * (2 Gy / fraction dose in Gy)
physical_meaning: Monitor units normalized to a standard 2 Gy fraction.
inputs_required: Plan MU, prescription, fraction count, beam list

mathematical_definition: MUCA = MUs / N_control_arcs
physical_meaning: Average monitor units delivered per control arc.
inputs_required: Plan MU, prescription, fraction count, beam list

mathematical_definition: Fraction dose = prescribed dose / number of fractions
physical_meaning: Dose prescribed per fraction.
inputs_required: Plan MU, prescription, fraction count, beam list

mathematical_definition: Fractions = N_fx
physical_meaning: Number of planned treatment fractions.
inputs_required: Plan MU, prescription, fraction count, beam list

mathematical_definition: MUcGy = MUs / prescribed dose in cGy
physical_meaning: Monitor units delivered per centigray of prescribed dose.
inputs_required: Plan MU, prescription, fraction count, beam list

mathematical_definition: LT = weighted mean over control arcs of total leaf travel between adjacent apertures

inputs_required: MLC leaf positions, jaw positions, gantry angle, and control-point meterset weights
notes: For Halcyon/Ethos-style plans, the workflow also exports per-layer MLCX1 and MLCX2 variants.
